summary: Full backend + frontend e2e testing of Green-Haus landing page. 10/10 pytest tests pass (health, root, contact valid/invalid/persistence, quote valid full+minimal/invalid/persistence). UI testing via Playwright confirmed all 7 sections, all 5 product cards (with EUR prices), navbar scroll, quote dialog open/fill/submit (success toast + dialog closes), contact form submit (success toast + form clears), founder portrait placeholder text present, and footer 'Green-Haus © 2026'. Resend is in sandbox so backend returns status='received' (expected) and persists every inquiry in db.inquiries — verified for both contact and quote.

issues: data-testid 'founder-portrait-placeholder' wraps the Avatar fallback ('NA') along with the 'Founder portrait' caption — text_content reads as 'NAFounder portraitWill be uploaded here'. The required substring 'Founder portrait' is present, so this is cosmetic only; consider scoping the test-id to just the caption text node for cleaner DOM semantics.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is clean and modular (<200 lines). Pydantic validation with EmailStr + min_length is solid; 422 returned for all invalid payloads as expected.
Inquiry record uses uuid.uuid4() id + ISO created_at — no MongoDB ObjectId leakage in responses (responses don't echo the doc back, which is fine).
Resend send is offloaded to thread via asyncio.to_thread — non-blocking and email failure is swallowed (record marked email_status='failed') which is correct sandbox behavior per problem statement.
Frontend correctly uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL with /api prefix. Axios error handling shows toast with backend detail.
All interactive elements have data-testid as required.
seed_data_creation: Test inquiries created during pytest were cleaned up via db.inquiries.delete_one after each test. Two extra inquiries from the Playwright UI run remain in db.inquiries (pw_tester@example.com quote + contact_pw@example.com contact) — harmless test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_green_haus_api.py covers health, contact, and quote with DB persistence assertions. Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/test_green_haus_api.py -v. Resend is in sandbox — status='received' is the expected success response (not a bug). All sections, products, navbar, quote dialog, and contact form work end-to-end.
